the_finding_that_outlives_the_goal.headline: The failure is a property of the join mechanism, not of either host's disk retention — and not of the idea being tested.
the_finding_that_outlives_the_goal.evidence: The local fail was originally diagnosed as structural to local disk retention, i.e. a host property. The alt field refutes that: alt has full transcript retention over its entire event history and still ceilings at 27.4%. Retention modulates the number (12.6% local, 27.4% alt) but does not cause the failure.
the_finding_that_outlives_the_goal.mechanism: The only tier that finds transcripts at scale, event_id_echo, matches an event because its recall_event_id was written into the transcript — and the dominant reason an id lands there is the memory_remember provenance that CONSUMES it. The join is therefore closer to a consumption detector than to a neutral link, which is why the consumed share among matched events is ~3.5x the store-wide rate on BOTH fields, holding inside every comparable calendar month on both.
the_finding_that_outlives_the_goal.the_sharpest_form_of_the_problem: On alt, delivery_record_index — the anchor the grading method requires, because grading must begin strictly after the delivery instant — is present on exactly the 4257 event_id_echo rows and NULL on all 169 transport_session rows. Every event the prescribed method could grade comes from the consumption-detector tier; every event from the non-detector tier is ungradeable for want of a delivery instant. The bias is not merely large, it is structurally inseparable from the method.

consequence_for_the_goal_s_value_claim.claim: «Обучающий сигнал петли ... вырастает кратно (~×5 по покрытию событий)»
consequence_for_the_goal_s_value_claim.reading: Even granting every silent matched event a grounded verdict — an upper bound no real threshold would reach — the event-coverage multiplier is ~1.8x on alt and ~1.2x on local, against a ~5x claim. The ~5x figure presumed a join that reaches most silent recalls; neither field's join does.
consequence_for_the_goal_s_value_claim.status: derived here from the recorded counts, not pre-registered; the local baseline is back-derived from the recorded store-wide share and is approximate to the unit

the_finding_that_outlives_the_goal.reopening_condition: Not another host, and not better join tiers. Reopening requires prospective instrumentation that records the delivery instant for recalls independently of whether a memory_remember later consumes them — so that the joinable population stops being selected by the very outcome the signal is meant to predict.
